name: memo-agent-did-mainnet
description: Create and operate a locally controlled MEMO chain-985 Agent DID without exporting its private key.

interface.shortDescription: Create and connect a local chain-985 Agent DID
interface.longDescription: Check identity storage on your computer or an explicitly selected long-lived host, then create a locally encrypted Agent DID when requested. Register through the MEMO Agent DID platform and approve wallet management relationships.
defaultPrompt: Use $memo-agent-did-mainnet on my computer or my explicitly selected long-lived host to finish runtime setup and check identity storage with doctor; report blockers without creating an identity or generating a fallback master key.
